nodes.text: Möbius is a new kind of app — built on the premise that what matters to you should get deeper over time, not disappear into a feed. One place for the friendships, communities, and continuities that define your life.
Free while in beta · via Apple TestFlight
Everything you contribute builds into something. Nothing scrolls away. Return to any relationship and find it deeper than you left it.
Your data lives on your device. The server coordinates — it can't read your content. Not by policy. By cryptography.
Designed for presence, not retention. No engagement metrics. No attention economy. The economics are aligned with depth, not volume.
An online place to hang out with friends and friends-of-friends with no ads or brands or influencers or 'algorithm.'
Möbius holds several ways to be together. Each one is its own thing.
Tap a card to see what you can do with it.
Talk to the people who matter, in voice messages that carry the texture of actually being heard. Your voice and theirs, deepening over time.
voice notes that never scroll away
Send a voice blip and keep adding to it
React the moment you pause while listening
Return to a conversation as it builds
A card game you play with the people you're closest to. Every round becomes part of the relationship — the game isn't separate from the friendship.
a deck you share with one person
Play against a friend or pass-and-play
Match on rank and color to score
Let the play become shared history
Safe infrastructure for communities that organize. Power-mapping, mutual aid without spectacle, and coalition coordination — built by thinking about who gets targeted first.
the tool the movement never had
See a community's shape emerge from its work
Pool mutual aid without anyone performing need
Coordinate across communities with no hub to seize
Public conversation that builds over time instead of scrolling away. The positions you take stay visible; the discourse accumulates depth like a private relationship does.
Browse conversations by human need, not algorithm
Read a discussion as it happened, or by where people agree
Start a convo that's still there next year
